description: This PHP source file contains functions to generate user privilege and sharing permission files for the vtiger CRM system. It includes functions to create privilege files for individual users, handle sharing permissions, and retrieve sharing objects for modules, focusing on user roles, groups, and module-specific sharing rules.

methods.name: createUserPrivilegesfile
methods.description: Generates a PHP file containing user privilege information, including roles, profiles, and admin status, for a specific user ID.

methods.name: createUserSharingPrivilegesfile
methods.description: Creates a PHP file with sharing permissions and rules for a specific user, including module-specific sharing rules and role/group permissions.

methods.name: getUserModuleSharingObjects
methods.description: Retrieves sharing objects (roles, groups, users) with which a specific user shares data for a given module, based on sharing rules and permissions.
